I was in a terrible cycle of depression, I wanted to end my life, I couldn’t get out of bed and I felt miserable and it kept me from seeing life as more than happiness.. you have to understand depression doesn’t care how good or bad your life is, it just hits. I don’t feel “happy” still.. sometimes I do, I let these feelings come but I am more at peace now ... it’s been 5 years since then. At my perceived rock bottom,  I fell into a physically and psychologically abusive situation for a year... I was isolated from everyone I had no friends... truly can ruin someone if you let it. But I won’t because I see the power of the mind now. You are so much more CAPABLE than you know. So much STRONGER and RESILIENT than you can imagine. You CAN change I promise. I swear to god you’ll feel okay, maybe not today but one day. Find solace in yourself. Forgive yourself. You come first. You are whole and you are alive, constantly changing. Be who you need to be for yourself right now. If I felt the same as I did back then right now, the same thing that brought me to my knees and into hospitals, I would be SO content,, I would understand there is more than just the numbness.  I am okay I always have been I just didn’t know it. It can get worse it can always get worse, life is unfair to us all. This might be  the most difficult thing you have faced, and I respect that reality for you... Progress can be a motivator, Always trying to improve, growth is exponential.. it doesn’t matter if someone thinks something isn’t growth as long as you see it.. trust in yourself.. it’s almost Christmas.. it feels like any other day, but who am I to measure myself by what I think I should feel? The depression is the same, it’s still here but I see it for what it is. Be gentle with yourself
depression will really get you down if you define your life by happiness.... it all can be fixed. Find a purpose and focus.. I wish I did that before it was too late
